dogecoin.text: @TonyBurnetti I still can’t get over the idea of using a camera to film a screen. I haven’t even started processing the DogeCoin part.

SpaceX wants companies to fight over pixels on the side of a satellite. The satellite will have a selfie-stick that records the screen and streams it back to earth for people to watch. You can pay for pixels with DogeCoin. I wish I were making this up.
